# Russian Wikipedia

> A free, collaborative online encyclopedia in Russian language powered by MediaWiki, offering comprehensive knowledge across all domains with community-driven content creation and quality control.

Russian Wikipedia (ru.wikipedia.org) is part of the Wikimedia Foundation's mission to provide free access to knowledge. It serves as a primary reference resource for Russian-speaking users, featuring article creation tools, editing guides, quality assurance processes, and extensive coverage of Russian history, language, and culture.

## Key Topics

- Wikipedia
- MediaWiki
- Free content
- Russian language
- Article editing
- Quality control
- Content moderation
- Getting started
- Russian history
- Encyclopedia
- Vandalism prevention
- Article review
- Wikipedia policy
- Wikimedia Foundation
- Community contribution
